title: Retail Team Lead (Berlin Flagship Store)
description:
Join Tylko, Where Design Meets Technology

Founded in Warsaw, Poland, in 2015, Tylko is redefining how we design, shop for, and experience furniture. Frustrated by mass-produced, one-size-fits-all solutions, the team created something smarter: bespoke storage that balances cutting-edge technology, premium craftsmanship, and sustainable production.

With millimetre-perfect precision, every piece is made-to-order and crafted locally, minimising waste and maximising longevity. The result? A new standard in furniture – one that fits your space, your style, and your life.

Why It Matters

We’re not just building furniture. We’re changing how people think about living with it. By merging technology and design, we help people create spaces that truly reflect who they are. If you believe that good design can make everyday life better, you’ll feel right at home here.

How We Work

We believe in small teams, big ideas, and simple processes. No endless paperwork, no silos. Just open communication, shared goals, and a healthy dose of curiosity. We start small, think big, and move fast, because progress always beats perfection.

At Tylko, collaboration and trust aren’t buzzwords — they’re how we work. From day one, you’re part of a team that makes real decisions and brings them to life together. You’ll have the freedom to share ideas, turn them into action, and shape the space around you literally. Here, learning isn’t a bonus. It’s part of the job.

AI is part of how we work - it's not an add-on here. We treat it like any other tool worth knowing: it helps us think, decide, and move faster. We're not looking for people who "know AI" - we're looking for people curious enough to rethink how they work altogether. You don't need to be an expert on day one - you need the drive to grow.

About the Role

As our Retail Team Lead at the Berlin Flagship Store, you’ll play a key role in creating a high-performing team and an exceptional customer experience. Working closely with the Store Manager, you’ll turn our commercial and operational goals into everyday results - inspiring the team, driving sales performance, and making sure every customer leaves with a great impression.

You’ll be a hands-on leader who brings energy to the team, sets the standard for excellent service, and helps every team member perform at their best. From hitting daily targets to creating a welcoming, inspiring in-store experience, you’ll have a direct impact on both our people and our business.

What You’ll Do

You’ll take ownership, make things happen, and see your impact. Specifically, you will:

  • Drive active selling on the floor to consistently achieve daily sales targets

  • Support the Store Manager in motivating the retail team to achieve daily sales, service, and operational objectives

  • Communicate priorities, targets, procedures, and feedback clearly to ensure the team remains aligned

  • Coach team members through regular feedback, on-the-job training, and individual development

  • Ensure efficient and continuous store operations, stepping up during the Store Manager's absence

  • Assist in implementing visual merchandising guidelines, product displays, and promotions

  • Oversee inventory management tasks including stock counts, replenishment, and loss prevention

What we offer for this particular role

  • A chance to shape Tylko’s flagship retail presence and influence our physical retail strategy

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus

  • Employee discount on Tylko products

  • Inspiring work environment in the heart of Berlin

  • Opportunity to grow within a fast-scaling European design brand

  • Access to training, development, and cross-team collaboration with HQ


What we’re looking for

  • +2 years of experience in retail or gastronomy, with a strong understanding of sales and KPI management

  • Passion for design, furniture, and architecture - supported by studies or strong personal interest

  • Excellent communication skills in German and English - approachable and confident - able to quickly build trust, understand customer needs, and offer thoughtful, personalised design advice

  • Skilled at explaining technical product details in a simple, engaging, and passionate way

  • Expertise in retail operations, encompassing opening/closing procedures, cash handling, inventory management, and compliance

  • Solid understanding of customer service procedures, handling complaints, returns, escalations, and service recovery

  • Hands-on experience in visual merchandising and delivering structured operational training to team members

  • Comfort in using POS systems, retail technology, scheduling tools, and CRM systems

  • Readiness for stationary and shift work at our Berlin store


Ready to Design the Future with Us?

If you’re looking for a place where your ideas matter, your curiosity is fuel, and your work has real impact — let’s talk. Join Tylko and help us make furniture smarter, homes happier, and everyday life a little more beautiful.

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | International Ecommerce | Berlin ASAP
description:
ennovationHUB is a fast-growing international e-commerce group operating in the home & living category, with a strong focus on furniture. From our hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we serve customers across the UK, North America, EU, and APAC.

As we scale toward €160m+ annual revenue by 2027, we are looking for a Senior Google Ads Specialist to join us ASAP and take ownership of the Google Ads performance of one of our brands within our portfolio, with direct accountability for growth, efficiency, and profitability.

This is not a typical agency PPC role focused on managing a handful of campaigns. You will be working inside a multi-brand international e-commerce group with significant advertising budgets, multiple markets, and direct visibility into how your work impacts revenue and profitability.

Google Ads is a core part of our growth strategy. We operate across multiple countries and brands, creating both complexity and opportunity. We are looking for people who enjoy working with large datasets, finding performance opportunities, and continuously improving results through testing, analysis, and execution.

You will work closely with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists to ensure campaigns are not only performing well today but continue to scale efficiently as the business grows.

  • Take ownership of Google Ads performance for one e-commerce brand across multiple international markets

  • Manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns across Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign types

  • Monitor and improve key performance metrics including ROAS, CPA, conversion rate, revenue, and profitability

  • Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and performance within your portfolio

  • Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience segments

  • Analyse campaign data and turn insights into actionable recommendations

  • Conduct account audits and implement ongoing optimisation initiatives

  • Work closely with developers and analytics teams to ensure accurate tracking and measurement

  • Collaborate with creative and content teams to improve ad performance and landing page effectiveness

  • Support budget planning, forecasting, and performance reporting

  • Stay current with platform developments, AI-driven advertising features, and industry best practices

  • Contribute to testing strategies and experimentation frameworks that improve long-term account performance

You will not be joining a business that is trying to figure out whether Google Ads works. It already does. Your role is to help us take performance to the next level by identifying opportunities, improving efficiency, and scaling what works. We operate in a competitive e-commerce environment where small improvements can have a significant impact.

You will be working with experienced colleagues who move quickly and care about results. We value people who can think independently, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of outcomes. This is not a support role and it is not a reporting role. You will be trusted to make decisions, own results, and have a direct impact on the growth of the business.


This role is strictly for candidates with in-house e-commerce experience. Candidates whose primary Google Ads experience comes from agencies, consultancies, or freelance work will not be considered.

We are looking for people who have owned performance outcomes inside an e-commerce business, where success is measured by revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and long-term growth rather than client management and campaign delivery. You should have experience working directly within a commercial business and be comfortable taking ownership of results, not simply providing recommendations.

Our Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns

  • Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads for an e-commerce business, with direct responsibility for performance and profitability

  • Strong experience with Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns

  • Proven experience working as part of an in-house e-commerce team rather than as an agency, consultant, or freelancer

  • Comfortable analysing large datasets and identifying actionable insights

  • Strong understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement

  • Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center

  • Highly analytical with strong attention to detail

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken

  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities

  • Curious, proactive, and focused on continuous improvement

  • Able to take ownership and make decisions independently

  • We are actively pushing AI and automation across the business, so you need to be comfortable working in that direction and not resistant to change

  • Senior, but practical

  • Data-driven without becoming overly theoretical

  • Comfortable taking ownership and making decisions

  • Naturally curious and always looking for performance improvements

  • Focused on outcomes rather than activity

  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution

  • Motivated by building and scaling rather than simply maintaining campaigns

  • Available to start immediately / ASAP

We are investing in building a stronger presence there and expect it to become an increasingly important location for our team over time. Our wider team is spread across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou.

The role requires travel approximately every 4-8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, London, or other team locations for planning sessions, workshops, team gatherings, and strategic discussions. While most work is done remotely, we believe that spending time together in person remains valuable, particularly as the company continues to scale.

This is a long-term opportunity for someone who wants to play a meaningful role in scaling an international e-commerce business over the coming years.

In Our Culture at ennovationHUB, We Value:

  • Accountability over excuses

  • Execution over talk

  • Clarity over politics

  • Learning through doing

We welcome people from diverse backgrounds. What matters most is doing the work well, taking ownership, and helping the business move forward.

How we work

description:
About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO. It combines deep expertise with an AI-native operating model designed to deliver better evidence, faster execution and stronger client outcomes.

Through direct access to the expertise needed to solve complex challenges and a pace of delivery that enables organisations to seize opportunities, Unity delivers advisory as it should be, through a model that is free from audit conflict.

The Role

As a Senior Manager in our Deals and Value Capture team, you'll lead commercial performance improvement and value capture engagements for PE-backed and corporate clients across the deal and ownership lifecycle; from value-focused CDD and GTM diagnostics, through implementation and ongoing performance improvement, to exit readiness.

Our work spans the full commercial operating system: market, customer and value proposition; GTM model and channel strategy; marketing and sales effectiveness; pricing and monetisation; customer success, retention and expansion; commercial operations and Lead-to-Cash; and AI, analytics and data enablement. You'll bring these levers together into a practical, integrated plan rather than treating them as separate workstreams.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You'll lead workstreams day-to-day, build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and take ownership for moving from diagnosis to implementation. You'll also work closely with the Director/Partner group to shape the practice, feed in what is working on the ground and sharpen our proposition as we build it out.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end commercial performance improvement engagements, spanning value-focused GTM diagnostics, value capture execution, and ongoing performance improvement.

  • Diagnose where commercial value is created or lost using customer, commercial, operational and financial qualitative and quantitative data points; quantify the opportunity and link recommendations to revenue, margin, EBITDA and cash outcomes.

  • Design and deliver work across market segmentation, ICP and value proposition; GTM and channel strategy; marketing effectiveness; sales productivity, pipeline and forecasting; pricing and monetisation; and customer success, retention and expansion.

  • Help clients to build the commercial operating system required to sustain improvement, including GTM processes, commercial governance and operating cadence, and KPI definitions and incentives.

  • Translate analysis into execution through prioritised value cases, 100-day plans, pilots, playbooks, sales motions, adoption measures and benefits tracking, taking ownership for delivered outcomes, not just recommendations.

  • Create clear, decision-ready materials for management teams, boards and investors, including KPI baselines, performance dashboards, value creation roadmaps and diligence-ready evidence packs.

  • Manage day-to-day client relationships with senior stakeholders across commercial, finance, operations, technology and data, acting as the primary point of contact for engagement delivery.

  • Project manage multidisciplinary engagement teams, ensuring quality, pace and commercial impact while coaching and developing junior team members.

  • Contribute to proposals and pitches, including scoping, costing and drafting client-ready materials; identify follow-on opportunities within existing client relationships.

  • Develop Unity's commercial performance improvement IP, tools and methodology based on live engagement experience and reusable approaches across the portfolio.

Qualifications

  • 8-10 years of consulting or relevant industry experience in front-office, GTM, commercial transformation or performance improvement.

  • A track record of leading commercial transformation or value creation engagements from diagnosis through implementation, ideally including PE-backed portfolio company work.

  • Strong grounding across several commercial levers - for example GTM strategy, marketing or sales effectiveness, pricing, customer success, RevOps or Lead-to-Cash - with the judgement to connect them into an integrated answer.

This is a hybrid role based out of London. You'll work with AI-native tools built into how we deliver, and get a level of exposure to how the practice is run that's hard to find at a larger firm.

title: Broker Development Manager
description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE 

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

🚀 Our story

Partly is connecting the world's parts, and we're doing that by building the AI infrastructure layer for the global repair industry, starting with the $2tn automotive market. Our frontier model, Interpreter, is the world's first AI purpose-built to understand vehicle damage and the parts needed to fix it. Thousands of businesses across the global repair supply chain already rely on it.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've tripled in size in the last 18 months and have recently raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify) and including Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree, and Ecliptic Venture Capital. We're headquartered in Austin, with offices in New Zealand and London.

We're continuing to build a world-class team ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built, and our values are lived throughout every experience.

Want to learn more about the problems we're solving and the culture we're building at Partly? Hear directly from our team here: https://shorturl.at/iAFUX

🖍️ This role

This is a forward-deployed solutions role at the front line of Partly's European expansion. You'll be the technical engine behind new-market deals across the UK and the Nordics, turning messy real-world problems into signed pilots and putting genuinely differentiated AI in front of the people who run the repair industry.

Here's what you'd be working with. Partly runs two connected layers. Partly.com is the infrastructure platform, the B2B layer that powers parts data, cataloging, and procurement across hundreds of integrations globally. Partly.ai is the AI tool for repairers, built on top of that infrastructure, that makes finding and sourcing the right part feel like magic. Both are powered by Interpreter, Partly's proprietary foundation model for understanding automotive parts at scale, trained on licensed OEM build data across 52+ manufacturer agreements and continuously sharpened by feedback from thousands of users across our global network. No general-purpose AI model comes close on parts accuracy, and that is what makes agentic procurement automation possible at the precision the repair industry demands.

Your job is to deploy that into markets we haven't cracked yet. Automotive data is scattered around the world in complex, inconsistent formats, and the interesting work is in unifying it into something that drives a customer's business. You'll sit between Sales, Product, and Engineering, resolving the technical blockers that stand between a prospect and a deal, building demos and experimental features that show off what Interpreter can do, and shaping how the product gets built for and applied to each new market.

Why join now: Partly closed a $50M Series B at a $500M valuation and is scaling fast across the UK, Europe, the U.S., and Australasia, in a $1.9 trillion industry that has barely been touched by modern software. You'd be early, close to the founders and the model, and given real ownership from day one. If you like ambiguity, owning a problem end to end, and being the person who makes a deal technically possible with frontier AI, this role is built for you.

Stand up and debug the connections customers depend on (for example, the CABAS estimating integration for Nordic customer pilots or quick custom interfaces for client-facing demos), working close to the data and the code to get them live in test and beyond.

  • Build demos and experimental features. Create market demos and portal prototypes that prove what Partly can do before committing core engineering, iterating fast on what prospects react to.

  • Run Technical Readiness Assessments. Produce the TRAs that map a customer's systems and dependencies so both sides know exactly what a pilot requires.

  • Turn data into a commercial case. Build value proposition frameworks, calculators, and reporting (for example, insurer reporting dashboards) that show customers the value in their own numbers.

  • Be the voice of the UK and Nordics customer to Product. Translate recurring deal blockers into clear, prioritized product asks, and shape how the product gets built and applied for each new market.

  • Work cross-functionally to hit deadlines. Coordinate across Sales, Product, and Engineering to solve customer problems and keep deals moving.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

About the role

Quality at Lendable is a team-level responsibility with participation from PMs, EMs and engineers to ensure the right guardrails are in place to deliver quality software. We aggressively automate across the whole test pyramid and only manually test where absolutely necessary.

We’re hiring a Head of Quality to be accountable for engineering quality across the organisation, while local responsibility for delivering quality stays with each team. As we grow in headcount and customer numbers, this role keeps the bar high by taking signals from our existing quality processes, evolving our quality gates, and enabling teams rather than gatekeeping them. It is a hands-on role with a managerial aspect.

The role will take the lead on using AI in the quality process. Innovating with LLMs to improve efficiency and accuracy of testing.

What good looks like: in your first 12 months:

  • Reduction in incident rate per PR.

  • SLO coverage across services meaningfully increases.

  • Introduction of effective AI-assisted quality tooling in the SDLC.

  • Effective risk based quality reporting on quality.


What you'll be doing

Own the engineering quality of the organisation

Service Level Objectives

  • Monitor and report on SLO performance.

  • Engage teams to mature their SLO definitions.

  • Introduce systematic performance testing in the SDLC.

  • Ensure initiatives to improve SLO performance are completed.

Incidents

  • Own the follow-ups and resolutions from the incident process across engineering.

  • Ensure follow ups from incidents are completed.

From these and other sources Identify hotspots, catalogue and evaluate risks and recommend remediations.


How you’ll do this

Being Hands-on

This is not a pure managerial role. You will be engaging with teams, innovating with testing solutions and contributing code to test frameworks and CI pipelines..

Managing a team

  • Hiring and managing a team of ~2 Quality Engineers, they will be new hires to the company.

  • Deploying Quality Engineers into engineering teams to help them improve their quality.

  • Managing and supporting individuals that are embedded into different teams across the organisation

Driving a Quality Mindset

  • Evangelising quality across the organisation.

  • Work with MDs and other senior stakeholders to identify and create solutions to their quality challenges.

  • Embedding quality thinking into all phases of the SDLC, not just the testing part.

  • Looking for opportunities to shift-left the testing practices.

  • Forming a guild of Quality representatives across the organisation.

Running Initiatives

  • Scoping and inserting quality initiatives onto teams roadmaps.

  • Championing these initiatives with senior stakeholders

Developing the use of AI into the quality process

Bring tools and processes into the organisation to level-up our testing efficiency using AI. AI testing agents, AI test failure triage agents and AI observers for production environments.


Tech stacks you will be working with

Backend Coding: PHP, Kotlin, GO, Python
Frontend Coding: Typescript, React, React Native, GraphQL, Relay

Testing: PHPUnit, Behat, JUnit, Kotest, Jest, Maestro, K6

Observability: Datadog, Sentry, Incident.io, Grafana

Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ

Deployment: Argo, Github, Github Actions


What we're looking for

Essential

  • At least 7 years in quality related roles.

  • Run a number of QA initiatives across an organisation to improve the quality output across engineering teams.

  • Proven senior stakeholder management.

  • Experience working with quality across the stack. You have hands-on experience of testing backends and frontends. From functional to unit, performance and accessibility testing.

  • Have line managed a small team.

  • Worked with B2C products at scale (millions of users).

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Have shipped AI tooling into a quality process — this can be as simple as evaluating, buying and rolling out an off-the-shelf AI testing tool, through to building bespoke agents. You can describe the impact it had on how teams worked.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator, able to chase things down when blocked.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with using Datadog, Sentry or similar for monitoring.

  • Experience with incident.io or similar incident process.

  • Have managed SLOs and used them to improve quality.

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated B2C environments.

We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.

Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 

 
🛠️  Procurement Team @ Bloom & Wild Group
You’ll be joining the engine room of Bloom & Wild’s fastest-growing categories. While we are known for our flowers, our Procurement team provides the operational and supply chain foundation for our non-horticultural range. From fresh-baked treats and luxury hamper components to home, lifestyle, and the essential packaging that delivers the "wow" moment. 

Our team is divided into two clear pillars: Strategic Procurement and Stock Planning. As the Supply Chain Lead, you will report to the Head of Procurement & Inventory, acting as the architect of our operational procurement function and building the scalable systems we need to grow.

We are a team that "cares wildly" about impact. Working closely with partners across the business, we ensure the infrastructure is in place to support their vision. Our focus is on delivering perfect availability, optimising inventory health, and enabling rapid range expansion through robust operational processes. This is a rare opportunity to help shape a function from the ground up and see your work directly fuel our success as we scale. 


⚙️ What you'll be doing:

  • Build & Scale the Function You’ll be the architect of our non-horticultural stock planning strategy. This is a "build from scratch" opportunity where you will set the vision for how we scale, demonstrating the ability to turn rapid business growth into a sophisticated, high-performing operational machine

  • Master Stock Availability: You will lead your team to ensure optimal stock levels across all sites, balancing high availability with the need to minimise waste and holding costs. Navigating multi-site space constraints, you’ll work in lockstep with our Warehouse teams and Strategic Procurement Managers to ensure our supply is as efficient as it is reliable.

  • Develop & Automate: Build scalable, custom, automated supply chain and inventory tools and develop AI workflows to eliminate manual data entry and calculation tasks. You will lead the development of  agile, spreadsheet-based solutions while mapping the transition to long-term, robust systems.

  • Process & KPI Leadership Develop standardised processes and frameworks, leading weekly KPI reviews to shift the function from reactive problem-solving to proactive inventory and risk management. You’ll define what "success" looks like for the department.

  • Team Transformation & Development Provide oversight, coaching, and mentorship to a team of stock planners, transitioning them from manual execution to analytical decision-making. You will build internal succession and resilience, ensuring the team is equipped to handle increasing complexity.

  • Strategic Growth & Inventory Control De-risk the launch of new ranges by ensuring our operational infrastructure is mature enough to handle increased SKU counts. You'll collaborate with the commercial team to ensure right-size inventory levels to protect availability, de-risk peak periods, and release trapped cash, while developing third-party relationships (charities/discounters) to manage excess stock.

  • Operational Execution: Support with planning and execution when needed to ensure continuity (especially when issues occur or in peak times)

  • 3PW Performance Management: Measure and manage performance of our 3PW partner against agreed SLA terms

  • Supplier Performance: Build internal operational performance reporting and supplier tiering, put in place initiatives to improve operational supplier performance. 


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…
  • 5+ years experience in a procurement, purchasing, supply chain or supply planning role, with experience leading a team
  • Have a proven track record in supply chain scalability - You have experience managing exponential growth of SKUs by using technology and automation to absorb increasing complexity
  • Are tech-savvy and systems-oriented - You have strong capabilities in building automated tools using G-suite and other platforms, and have been leveraging AI to increase your impact in this area
  • Are a strong leader and mentor - You excel at coaching team members, fostering a performance culture centered around accountability and ownership of results and know how to manage your stakeholders effectively. 
  • Have a continuous improvement mindset - You are adept at identifying system limitations and establishing continuous feedback loops with your team to resolve and automate them further
  • Are proactive and hands-on - You are willing to be a direct contributor to enable scale , rolling up your sleeves to understand operational tasks to a high standard and covering gaps during peak periods or illness
  • Are commercially and data-driven 
  • You are motivated by protecting margins, eliminating P&L leakage driven by manual errors, and right sizing inventory levels to optimise working capital and cash flow.

title: Manager, International Customer Supply Chain, rhode
description:
About the Company
 
e.l.f. Beauty's purpose is to make the world a better place for every eye, lip, and face. 
 
Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, e.l.f. Hair, Well People, Naturium and rhode.
 
In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 7 consecutive years of net sales growth. This consistent, category-leading growth is a testament to the strength of our team, strategy, and portfolio of brands. 
 
Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 
 
Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us

The Manager, International Customer Supply Chain will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer and retail partner experience across rhode’s growing international business. This role will partner closely with Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Operations, international distributors and retail partners to ensure strong execution across order management, inventory flow, launch planning, and ongoing customer supply chain performance. This role will support multiple international markets and distribution partners, requiring strong coordination across regions and global supply chain processes.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires strong analytical skills, clear communication, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still being built. The ideal candidate is proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term process improvement.

A core focus of this role will be building strong relationships with key retail partners, understanding their supply chain requirements, supporting innovation and promotional planning, identifying and mitigating supply risks, and using customer data to improve in-stocks, fulfillment, and overall service levels.


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a key point of contact between rhode and international distributors and retail customer operations teams, supporting day-to-day execution and market-specific supply chain needs

  •  Continually assess opportunities to improve customer supply chain, reduce operational costs, and drive volume through supply chain metrics

  • Develop a deep understanding of each international distributor and retail partner’s distribution model, operational requirements, key metrics, and inventory planning needs

  • Strong analytical skills to produce qualitative/quantitative data (using Excel, PowerPoint, NetSuite, Tableau) that can be shared to drive business

  • Broad understanding of policies, processes and systems relating to retail distributor operations

  • Overseeing and ensuring smooth order processing and timely delivery across international customers, distributors, and retail partners with focus on Innovation planning and customer expansion

  • Provide weekly sell in data vs. forecast and any risks associated to the month/quarter plan to Finance, Sales and Operations stakeholders

  • Track & monitor weekly sell out data coupled with retailer in stock levels in partnership with Demand planning and Sales account leads

  • As needed, partner with international distributors, retailer Supply Chain & planning teams to drive additional orders or forecast adjustments guaranteeing appropriate inventory coverage

  • Track and report on key international customer supply chain KPIs, including fulfillment, in-stocks, service levels, on-time delivery, and potential chargeback risk

  • Internal and external collaboration for alignment and identifying opportunities

  • Participate and contribute to customer demand forecasting, maximizing forecast accuracy

  • Participate and influence assortment decisions aimed at optimizing sales and productivity by utilizing analytics, market research, consumer research, and customer intelligence

  • Partner closely with international teams, distributors, and cross-functional stakeholders to support new market launches, regional assortment expansion, and ongoing operational excellence.

  • Ability to connect internal functions to drive supply chain improvements (fill rate, on-time, in-stocks, reduce potential chargebacks, customer program execution) for the customer

  • Help educate and align internal teams on international customer expectations, distributor requirements, regional retailer requirements, and best practices for execution


    • What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain or another analytical field preferred or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in customer supply chain, retail operations, customer logistics, demand planning, supply planning, or related operational roles

  • Must have experience with Sephora and/or other global prestige beauty retailers

  • Experience supporting international retailers, distributors, or global customer supply chain operations.

  • Strong communication skills both verbal and written

  • Excellent Excel Skills and knowledge

  • Proven ability to build strong relationships with retail partners, internal cross-functional teams and deliver results

  • Ability to make thoughtful decisions when data is limited, ambiguous, or evolving

  • Experience managing multiple countries, distributors, or regional supply chain requirements 

  • Willingness to travel internationally is required

  • Location of Position: United Kingdom and European Union

title: Project Engineer (Data Centres & Industrials)
description:
About the role

Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for data centres and large industrials. We're looking for a Project Electrical Engineer to be the electrical owner on first-of-a-kind power projects - private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, MV and HV grid connections.

This is a technical role with a unique expanded scope to broader infrastructure project management. Early on you are the project manager: you hold the programme, the development budget and the external parties, from concept design through connection offer to design freeze and financial close. From there you stay on as the electrical owner through construction, commissioning and energisation, with a delivery team around you.


What you'll do

  • Own the programme and the development budget. Schedule from early concept to design freeze - siting, connection application, planning, consents, procurement, long-lead items - worked back from the customer's energisation date. Appoint and manage consultants, ICPs and study providers. Surface risk early and clearly communicate them to the stakeholders.

  • Own the electrical concept through to sign-off. Single-line diagrams, general arrangements, switchgear and plant layouts, cable routes, metering and comms architecture. Direct and interrogate the studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, earthing, power quality). Chair design reviews and stage gates, and take options to the Project Lead and customer with a recommendation.

  • Lead the grid interface. DNO, TO and NESO - applications and offers, technical requirements, securities and milestones, contestable and non-contestable scope, ICP/IDNO coordination, MPAN registration.

  • Budget ownership through completion. Credible capex inputs for the project model across plant, substation, civils and enabling works, with value engineering and optioneering. Then FAT/SAT witnessing, commissioning plans and sequences of operation, energisation and handover.

  • Take on what you haven't done before. First-of-a-kind means no precedent, no standard design and no colleague who's done it. Get to a working understanding of an unfamiliar technology or scope fast, and deliver it.


    • What you'll have

  • Master’s degree , or equivalent, in electrical or power systems engineering. CEng welcome, not essential.

  • 5+ years delivering energy or infrastructure projects, with a strong grounding in MV and HV systems.

  • Real infrastructure experience - substations, networks, industrial plant, data centres, utilities, water or transport. We care that you've dealt with ground conditions, easements, consents, tie-ins to live assets and construction sequencing. This is not a grid-only role.

  • You've personally held a programme and a budget on a development or pre-construction project.

  • A GB/European grid connection taken from connection offer to grid code compliance and energisation, with working knowledge of the Grid Code, CUSC, SQSS, G99/G100, ENA engineering recommendations and BS 7671.

  • Able to coordinate a multi-discipline design where you're not the expert in every discipline - and to spot a weak answer from a civil or mechanical engineer.

  • Comfortable as the single point of accountability with an incomplete picture, holding external parties accountable without formal authority.

  • Full UK driving licence and willing to travel to site.

title: Power Grid Analyst (Data Centres and Industrials)

Octopus is a rapidly growing, global energy business. We are looking for a grid analyst with a passion for understanding and designing electricity grids. title: Commercial Analyst (Data Centres and Industrials)
description:
About the role

Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for datacenters and large industrials. The deals are first-of-a-kind: private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, flexible load, novel grid connections.

This is a quantitative role with direct exposure to large-scale innovative power projects. You'll own the project model, build pricing strategies and directly participate to final investment decisions.

  • 3–5 years in a numerate commercial role - infrastructure or renewables development, project finance, banking, energy trading or origination, strategy or energy consultancy.

title: Applied AI Scientist - LLMs & Voice
description:
Our mission

We're making Africa the first cashless continent.

In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.

We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.

Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...

How you'll help us achieve it

Wave is now the largest financial institution in Senegal and Côte d'Ivoire, with millions of users, growing rapidly year on year. And, we're still in the early days of our product roadmap and potential impact on people's everyday lives.

We're helping millions of customers across West Africa access financial services through mobile money, and great support is fundamental to that. We believe the future of customer support lies in machines handling boring repetitive tasks so humans can focus on high value interactions that require empathy and creativity

As an Applied AI Scientist on our Support Automation product team, you will:

  • Be responsible for driving the quality of our automated support through evaluating and improving everything the team builds
  • Bridge research and production, building agent systems that ship into real products.
  • Contribute to autonomous voice and digital agents that power 10M+ customer interactions per month across West Africa. 
  • Build for the hardest edge cases: poor connectivity, low literacy, and languages with little training data.
  • Experiment with, evaluate, and integrate the latest voice and text models.
  • Own problems end-to-end, from problem discovery to running in production, working alongside product and engineering leaders who prioritize shipping real customer impact.

If you're energized by ownership, thrive on deep technical challenges, and want to build infrastructure that serves millions in emerging markets, let's talk.

Key Details

  • This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (US, UK, Spain, Kenya and Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso.
  • Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
  • Remote team members are expected to travel to our operational markets (e.g. Senegal or Côte d'Ivoire) at least once a year. Exceptions apply, but we've found this key to understanding our users and product.
  • Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary between $167,00 - $227,900 USD, plus a generous equity package.
  • Major benefits:
    • Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
    • 6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
    • Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
    • $10,000 annual charitable donation matching.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in AI/ML experience
  • Proven hands-on experience building with LLMs or AI systems (evaluation, RAG, embeddings, safety and guardrails etc.).
  • Strong foundations in statistics and ML theory.
  • Solid Python skills.
  • Track record taking AI/ML systems from prototype to production and care deeply about reliability, performance, and scalability.
  • Fluency with AI agents, with bonus points for deploying them as part of production systems
  • Bonus points:
    • Research background in speech or LLMs
    • Proven Voice AI experience (ASR, TTS, latency optimization, real-time streaming, voice agents)
    • Experience building customer support or conversational AI systems
    • You follow the latest research in speech and LLMs, and know how to translate papers into production wins
    • Familiarity with low-resource language challenges
    • Building in high-risk agent environments like finance
    • Fluent in English, (bilingual in French is a big bonus!)

You might be a good fit if you

    • Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and designing AI systems end-to-end without detailed specs
    • Obsess over evaluation – you've built frameworks to catch hallucinations, measure groundedness, and know when to trust your system
    • Balance research intuition with pragmatic engineering; you ship working systems, not just prototypes.
    • Like working with large datasets, complex pipelines, and modern ML infra (distributed training, feature stores, monitoring, etc.)

About engineering at Wave

We care about the big picture. We don't hire engineers to just ship tickets. We hire them to solve problems. That means caring deeply about outcomes, understanding context, and jumping in wherever something's broken, even if it's technically "not your area." When we see problems, inefficiencies, or opportunities to make something better, we act. We dig into operational issues, clarify fuzzy product specs, or step into unfamiliar code to help unblock teammates.

We move as fast as possible. Speed matters. It lets us try things quickly, get feedback early, and course-correct while it's cheap. So we write small PRs. We aim for MVPs. We leave TODOs and file follow-ups. We don't over-perfect v1. That said, we're building a financial product. Some things—like money movement, correctness, or security—deserve more caution.

We like boring technology. We favor tools that are reliable, well-understood, and easy to debug. This keeps us focused on solving meaningful problems instead of wrestling with unpredictable infrastructure. If a new technology helps us move faster, build safer, or solve a real need, we'll consider it. But we don't adopt tools just because they're new—we adopt them because they're right.

Simplicity is a strategy. It lets us focus our energy where it matters most: serving our users.

Recommended (optional):

We're currently receiving a high volume of submissions. To help us review genuine candidates faster, please send a JSON payload with your resume and/or any links as plain text via POST to this secure endpoint: https://api.wave.com/submit_resume

To authorize to this endpoint, you can use the following bearer token:  wave_ + (country code for any of our operating countries) + _ + [any characters of your choice].

You are encouraged to use a coding agent to generate the JSON and the request. This is intentionally quick - don't overthink it.

This task is optional and not required to apply. Please still submit your application through the normal form. We'll store the JSON payload for up to 30 days for review, then it will be deleted.

#LI-DH1 #LI-REMOTE

Our team

  • We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
  • We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
  • We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
  • We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
  • We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.

How to apply

Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.

We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.

Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
Our customer is an AI-powered SMS and voice platform built for the performance marketing world. Their technology helps lead generation companies, affiliate networks, and call center operations dramatically improve contact rates and conversion — the metrics that actually move the needle for their buyers. They're a lean, globally distributed team of 10 operating out of Spain and Dubai, moving fast and building for scale.

This is a company in an exciting early phase — the product works, customers are seeing results, and now it's time to build the pipeline. If you want to be the person who shapes how a high-potential B2B SaaS company goes to market, this is a rare chance to do exactly that alongside a hands-on CEO who gives real autonomy.

About the position 

As the first dedicated Senior Account Executive, you will build the entire direct sales motion from the ground up. This is a hunter-first role in the early phase — you'll prospect, pitch, and close — but the real differentiator is what happens next. Every account you close is yours to onboard, expand, and grow. You'll be the full customer relationship, not just the closing signature.

What you'll own:

  • Build and own the full sales pipeline — prospecting, outreach, demos, negotiation, and close
  • Farm every account you close: onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Set up the sales tech stack — CRM, outreach sequences, playbooks — aligned with the CEO

  • Genuine willingness to farm and grow accounts — not just close and move on

  • Contractor-first engagement with flexibility based on candidate preference
  • Fully remote — work from wherever you're most effective
  • Direct line to the CEO with genuine autonomy on day-to-day execution

title: Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS)
employer: The Copper River Family of Companies
description:
Coho Integrated Solutions is seeking a qualified Family Advocacy Intervention Specialist (FAIS) to support the Department of the Air Force Family Advocacy Program in Lakenheath, Suffolk, United Kingdom. The FAIS serves as a clinical provider and prevention specialist responsible for supporting intervention and secondary prevention efforts related to domestic abuse, child maltreatment, problematic sexual behavior in children and youth, and family wellness.

The FAIS may augment the services of the Family Advocacy Treatment Manager and is expected to perform the applicable clinical and prevention responsibilities associated with the FATM role.

Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

  • Provide clinical intervention, counseling, assessment, and case management services to individuals, couples, families, and groups.
  • Support assessment and treatment of domestic abuse and child maltreatment cases.
  • Conduct psychosocial, safety, risk, needs, and other clinical assessments as appropriate.
  • Develop and monitor individualized treatment and safety plans.
  • Provide psychotherapy, psychoeducation, crisis intervention, advocacy, and clinical casework.
  • Provide secondary prevention services addressing domestic abuse, child maltreatment, and problematic sexual behavior in children and youth.
  • Deliver New Leader Orientation and annual training to commanders, first sergeants, organizational leadership, and key agencies.
  • Serve as a prevention facilitator and installation FAP representative for the Community Action Team and other community organizations.
  • Develop, promote, and implement FAP prevention programs under the direction and approval of the FAP Manager.
  • Develop social marketing and outreach strategies to increase awareness of family maltreatment prevention resources.
  • Identify family violence trends and collaborate with FAP personnel and community organizations to target prevention efforts.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of prevention activities and support required program reporting.

Essential Job Qualifications and Requirements:

  • Clearance:
    • Must be eligible for and maintain required privileging within the Military Treatment Facility
    • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust determination in accordance with applicable contract and government requirements
  • Education, Licensure, and Certifications:
    • Must be a U.S.-licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW) or Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT)
      • LCSW: Master's degree from a CSWE-accredited school
      • LMFT: Master's degree from a COAMFTE-accredited Marriage and Family Therapy program, or an appropriately qualifying allied mental health degree with equivalent Marriage and Family Therapy study
    • Must maintain the applicable unrestricted professional license
    • Must meet all applicable clinical privileging requirements
    • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification
  • Required Experience:
    • LCSW: Two years of post-MSW experience within the last three years in a clinical/treatment setting
    • LMFT: Two years of experience within the last two years as a marriage and family counselor
    • Two years of full-time post-master's clinical counseling experience serving individuals who are abusive or abused
    • Demonstrated group therapy facilitation or co-leadership experience
    • Experience working with children, families, groups, professionals, and community agencies
  • Physical Requirements:
    • Ability to travel within the assigned area for outreach, prevention, and community activities
    • Ability to work in clinical, office, community, and other approved environments
  • Work Environment:
    • Work is performed in clinical, office, community, and outreach settings and may involve interaction with individuals and families experiencing sensitive or challenging circumstances

About Copper River & The Native Village of Eyak:

Owned by the Native Village of Eyak (NVE), a federally recognized Alaska Native Tribe, the Copper River Family of Companies are a collection of entities that deliver a complementary set of solutions and services to support the diverse missions and requirements of our clients. Proud participants of the Small Business Administration's (SBA) 8(a) Business Development Program since 2006, our companies consist of both current and graduation SBA 8(a) entities. It is our collective purpose to support the Tribe and diversify the NVE's ability to facilitate economic advancement.

The income generated from our companies helps the Native Village of Eyak fund health and social services, economic development, natural resource/environmental education, jobs, job training, and other benefits to the NVE in a manner that is consistent with Alaskan Native cultural values and traditions.

Copper River's Culture

The Copper River Family of Companies has a positive, supportive, and thriving culture. At the foundation of our culture is a focus on collaboration. No matter your role or which operating company you work for, we are ONE TEAM working toward the same goals for our customers and for our collective owner- The Native Village of Eyak. How we treat each other is just as important as the work we deliver.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
  • Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
  • Retirement 401(k) with employer match
  • Open leave policy and paid holidays
  • Additional benefits including tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more! 

Note: Benefits are offered based on employment classification and applicable contract requirements. Eligibility may vary by position.

title: Responsable Partenariats Terrain B2B H/F
description:
🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy !

Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance.
Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Contexte et objectifs de la mission

Afin de consolider sa croissance et d'accompagner au mieux ses clients dans la transition énergétique, Octopus Energy lance son programme de "Partenaires Certifiés". Notre ambition est de créer un réseau national d'artisans de confiance (experts en solaire, pompes à chaleur, véhicules électriques, etc.) pour proposer un parcours fluide à nos clients (travaux + fourniture d'énergie + pilotage).

En tant que responsable des partenaires, tu rejoins une "task force" de 3 personnes dédiée au lancement de cette nouvelle activité. Ton but ? Être le fer de lance commercial de ce projet. En véritable “intrapreneur·se” sur un projet où tout reste à construire, tu auras la charge de structurer, d'animer et de faire grandir ce réseau de partenaires stratégiques.


Missions principales

  • Prospection & signature : identifier, cibler et convaincre nos cibles prioritaires (notamment les partenaires Tiers 1) en fonction de nos marchés (pompes à chaleur, solaire, véhicules électriques, etc.) afin d'assurer la signature de nouveaux accords stratégiques.

  • Gestion de comptes & animation au quotidien : reprendre la gestion de nos 15 partenaires historiques et assurer l'onboarding, le suivi régulier et l'animation des nouveaux artisans signés. Tu seras leur point de contact privilégié pour les accompagner et garantir leur productivité sur nos offres.

  • Ambassadeur terrain & co-construction : en tant que véritable porte-parole du terrain, tu es responsable d'identifier, de qualifier et de faire remonter les "pain points" (irritants) des artisans. De nombreux déplacements sont à prévoir à l'échelle nationale (France métropolitaine) pour aller à la rencontre de notre réseau et le développer. Tu fais ainsi évoluer la proposition de valeur et le modèle économique en étroite collaboration avec le Chef de Projet et le Responsable de Programme.

  • Structuration et passage à l'échelle : participer activement à la mise en place de la plateforme Octopus Trusted Partners pour automatiser et fluidifier les processus (onboarding, distribution de leads, suivi). Garantir un niveau de qualité de service irréprochable de la part de nos partenaires afin de maintenir la satisfaction client au niveau de l'excellence visée par Octopus Energy.


    • Tes objectifs concrets

  • Co-construction de l’offre Partenaires : définir, valoriser et itérer en continu sur la proposition de valeur d’Octopus Energy à destination de notre réseau d'artisans.

  • Expansion Nationale (Vente du programme) : convaincre et signer les meilleurs artisans (notamment les Tiers 1) pour bâtir rapidement un maillage territorial solide. Ton objectif phare : couvrir 90 % de la France métropolitaine d'ici 6 mois.

  • Piloter la relation partenaire au quotidien autour de trois piliers stratégiques :

  • Génération de Valeur & Signatures : signer tes 3 premiers partenaires dédiés au traitement de nos leads, et piloter le flux de prospects qualifiés Octopus vers eux, en t'assurant d'un taux de transformation optimal sur le terrain.

  • Développement de services additionnels : en approche "test & learn", concevoir et déployer de nouvelles offres pour faciliter le quotidien de nos partenaires (ex: accompagnement sur l'ingénierie financière et les primes CEE sur le marché des pompes à chaleur).

  • Création d'Ambassadeurs (Prescription) : transformer chaque installateur partenaire en un véritable ambassadeur de la marque, capable de prescrire massivement nos contrats de fourniture d'énergie et nos offres de pilotage intelligent à ses clients.


    • Tes premiers mois au sein de l’équipe

    Mois 1 : Immersion & MVP (Minimum Viable Product)

  • Opérationnel·le dès le 1er jour : tu pars directement sur le terrain pour rencontrer nos partenaires historiques aux côtés de Félicien et Clémence.

  • Discours & Outils : tu co-construis le pitch commercial de prospection. En l'absence d'outils complexes, tu profites de cette page blanche pour définir et mettre en place les outils de base (MVP) nécessaires au lancement immédiat du projet.

    • Mois 2 : Autonomie & Build

  • Prise de Lead : tu deviens l'interlocuteur·trice principal·e et privilégié·e du réseau. Tu lances ta prospection et signes tes premiers "nouveaux partenaires" en totale autonomie.

  • Structuration : tu participes activement à la conception de la future plateforme Partenaires avec l'équipe Produit, afin de centraliser l'onboarding, les leads et la facturation.

    • Mois 3 : Scale & Itération

  • Optimisation continue : fort·e de tes premiers retours terrain, tu challenges nos modèles économiques initiaux.

  • Innovation : tu proposes de nouvelles approches de rémunération, de nouveaux services ou de nouvelles stratégies d'acquisition pour accélérer la croissance du réseau.


    • Profil recherché

  • Appétence commerciale et pugnacité : Tu as le goût du challenge et du terrain. Tu n'as pas peur de prospecter, de te confronter aux artisans et de traiter les objections avec aisance.

  • Esprit Intrapreneur : Tu rejoins un nouveau projet où "tout est à faire". Tu aimes construire en partant d'une feuille blanche, tester, apprendre et avancer en autonomie.

  • Team player : Le succès de ce projet repose sur le collectif. Tu sais travailler en étroite collaboration au sein de ta petite équipe dédiée (task force de 3 personnes).

  • Organisation et rigueur : Tu sais organiser ton activité en autonomie, en optimisant au fur et à mesure, notamment en mettant en place des processus clairs et automatisés.

  • Curiosité technique : Sans être un·e expert·e, tu as une forte appétence pour les métiers de la rénovation énergétique (chauffagistes, électriciens, installateurs solaires...) et tu en comprends rapidement les enjeux.

  • Maîtrise de l'anglais écrit & oral (min B2-C1) pour travailler avec nos collègues et les équipes sièges du UK.

  • Expérience : Une expérience préalable réussie en animation de réseau B2B, ainsi qu'une connaissance du secteur de l'ingénierie ou du BTP (pour comprendre le langage et les enjeux de nos artisans) sont fortement souhaitées.

  • Intelligence relationnelle et leadership : Doté·e d'un fort capital sympathie, tu sais fédérer tes interlocuteurs et leur donner envie de devenir de véritables ambassadeurs d’Octopus Energy sur le terrain.

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

    Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

title: Conseiller·ère commercial·e terrain B2C F/H
description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. 

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Mais on ne va pas tout te dire de nous tout de suite : on va surtout parler de toi

On a besoin de ton énergie pour faire passer toute la Bretagne au vert — en porte-à-porte, en stand, et partout où une bonne idée peut ouvrir une porte.

Ton quotidien, c’est l’action !
  • Prospecter & convaincre : À la rencontre de nouveaux clients, en porte-à-porte ou en stand. Chaque porte est une opportunité.

  • Accompagner & conseiller : Aide les foyers à réduire leur facture et leur impact grâce à des économies d'énergie et des écogestes simples.

  • La meilleure école de vente : Écouter, pitcher, s'adapter, signer. Chaque contrat activé = une commission directe.

  • S'amuser, avant tout : Sur le terrain, en stand, en équipe. On célèbre chaque victoire, petite ou grande !


    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si :
  • Tu as le contact humain et les échanges sincères sont dans ta nature.

  • Tu as un esprit de conquête et tu adores te dépasser.

  • Tu es résilient·e : un « non » ne t'arrête pas, c'est un échauffement qui te motive.

  • Tu es autonome et responsable : tu pilotes ta journée comme un indépendant, mais avec une équipe solide derrière toi.

  • Tu partages tes victoires et tu cherches un job qui a du sens.

    • Pas d'expérience dans l'énergie ? Aucun souci : on te forme. L'envie, elle, ne s'apprend pas.


    Ce qu'on te promet :
  • La reconnaissance : Ton travail est vu, valorisé et célébré. Ici, les efforts ne passent jamais inaperçus.

  • Ton épanouissement : Le terrain est exigeant, on le sait. Alors on prend soin de toi : cadre bienveillant, écoute, et une équipe qui t'aide à durer.

  • La liberté de proposer : Une idée pour vendre autrement ? Propose-la : ici, les bonnes idées deviennent des projets.

    • Une vraie formation : Formation complète dès ton arrivée sur le métier, l'offre et le terrain. On ne te lâche jamais seul·e.

    Une rémunération et des avantages qui donnent envie :

  • Un fixe attractif selon ton expérience et ton profil.

  • Un variable non plafonné : mieux tu vends, plus tu gagnes.

  • Des primes de performance & qualité + des challenges toute l'année.

  • Une prime de formation à la validation de la période d'essai.

  • Et de vrais plus : intéressement au capital, excellente mutuelle (Alan), forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge des transports au-delà du légal, congés pour projet associatif et équipement fourni.


    • Et la cerise sur le gâteau : Octopus Energy

    Nous, on veut faire passer tout le monde au vert, dans une entreprise qui met le client au cœur de tout. Résultat : le meilleur score des fournisseurs d'énergie français sur Google Reviews et Trustpilot, 5ᵉ fournisseur français en 10 ans. Côté équipe, nous sommes classés n°1 au Great Place to Work 2026 (catégorie +200 salariés) et figurons au palmarès Best Workplaces for Women.

    Et si dans ta tête tu entends « Allez, pourquoi pas ? » — Postule !

  • Entretiens et prise de poste rapides 

  • Avant de signer : une journée d'immersion sur le terrain avec l'équipe. Tu vois le vrai métier, et on se choisit mutuellement.

Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. 

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Mais on ne va pas tout te dire de nous tout de suite : on va surtout parler de toi

On a besoin de ton énergie pour faire passer toute la Bretagne au vert — en porte-à-porte, en stand, et partout où une bonne idée peut ouvrir une porte.

 

 

Ton quotidien, c’est l’action !
  • Prospecter & convaincre : À la rencontre de nouveaux clients, en porte-à-porte ou en stand. Chaque porte est une opportunité.

  • Accompagner & conseiller : Aide les foyers à réduire leur facture et leur impact grâce à des économies d'énergie et des écogestes simples.

  • La meilleure école de vente : Écouter, pitcher, s'adapter, signer. Chaque contrat activé = une commission directe.

  • S'amuser, avant tout : Sur le terrain, en stand, en équipe. On célèbre chaque victoire, petite ou grande !


    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si :
  • Tu as le contact humain et les échanges sincères sont dans ta nature.

  • Tu as un esprit de conquête et tu adores te dépasser.

  • Tu es résilient·e : un « non » ne t'arrête pas, c'est un échauffement qui te motive.

  • Tu es autonome et responsable : tu pilotes ta journée comme un indépendant, mais avec une équipe solide derrière toi.

  • Tu partages tes victoires et tu cherches un job qui a du sens.

    • Pas d'expérience dans l'énergie ? Aucun souci : on te forme. L'envie, elle, ne s'apprend pas.


    Ce qu'on te promet :
  • La reconnaissance : Ton travail est vu, valorisé et célébré. Ici, les efforts ne passent jamais inaperçus.

  • Ton épanouissement : Le terrain est exigeant, on le sait. Alors on prend soin de toi : cadre bienveillant, écoute, et une équipe qui t'aide à durer.

  • La liberté de proposer : Une idée pour vendre autrement ? Propose-la : ici, les bonnes idées deviennent des projets.

  • Une vraie formation : Formation complète dès ton arrivée sur le métier, l'offre et le terrain. On ne te lâche jamais seul·e.

    • Une rémunération et des avantages qui donnent envie :

  • Un fixe attractif selon ton expérience et ton profil.

  • Un variable non plafonné : mieux tu vends, plus tu gagnes.

  • Des primes de performance & qualité + des challenges toute l'année.

  • Une prime de formation à la validation de la période d'essai.

  • Et de vrais plus : intéressement au capital, excellente mutuelle (Alan), forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge des transports au-delà du légal, congés pour projet associatif et équipement fourni.


    • Et la cerise sur le gâteau : Octopus Energy

    Nous, on veut faire passer tout le monde au vert, dans une entreprise qui met le client au cœur de tout. Résultat : le meilleur score des fournisseurs d'énergie français sur Google Reviews et Trustpilot, 5ᵉ fournisseur français en 10 ans. Côté équipe, nous sommes classés n°1 au Great Place to Work 2026 (catégorie +200 salariés) et figurons au palmarès Best Workplaces for Women.

    Et si dans ta tête tu entends « Allez, pourquoi pas ? » — Postule !

  • Entretiens et prise de poste rapides 

  • Avant de signer : une journée d'immersion sur le terrain avec l'équipe. Tu vois le vrai métier, et on se choisit mutuellement.

    • Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler chez nous ?

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Comme tu l’as certainement vu, c’est un montant fixe qui est indiqué dans la partie salariale. La raison pour laquelle il s’agit d’un salaire défini et non d’une fourchette est que pour ce poste, la grille salariale est la même pour tout le monde : chacun·e travaille sur le même sujet et démarre au même niveau de responsabilités, il nous semble donc juste que tout le monde dans l’équipe soit au même salaire à son démarrage. Ton évolution sera elle plus personnelle et dépendra aussi d’objectifs individuels.

    Si tu souhaites mieux comprendre la manière dont nous fixons nos salaires mais également en savoir plus sur les avantages dont tu bénéficieras si tu nous rejoins, n’hésite pas à poser la question lors de ton premier contact avec nous ! Nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un.e ne postule pas chez Octopus - Ce qui est le plus important pour nous, c'est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

By embedding our design guidelines directly into our system, you will ensure that automated outputs and dynamically generated code inherit the premium feel, clear hierarchy, and visual polish that define the Malt brand.

  • Applied AI Literacy: You understand how Large Language Models handle structured data, interact with data schemas, and how to structure context to support predictable UI layouts.
